items.title: Hanson 'disappointed' after losing racial discrimination appeal
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson loses an appeal against a court ruling which found she racially discriminated against Greens senator Mehreen Faruqi.

items.title: Risk consultant defends arming private security at Jewish events
items.description: A royal commission on antisemitism has pressed a risk and security consultant on his belief that the private security sector should be armed when protecting open air events.

items.title: Settler violence in the West Bank escalates after violent clash
items.description: More than 130 Palestinians have been detained in weekend raids across the occupied West Bank, according to Israel's military, following a deadly clash between settlers and Palestinians last week.

items.title: Fugitive developer sought influence via ex-premier’s brothers, ICAC told
items.description: The corruption watchdog has heard that fugitive developer Jean Nassif allegedly sought to use former NSW premier Dominic Perrottet's brothers to influence government decisions.

items.title: Live: Government says AusAlert test 'very successful' after reaching 94pc of cell towers
items.description: Millions of mobile phones and devices have been sent warning signals as part of the nationwide AusAlert emergency system trial. Follow live.

items.title: Deputy premier to run for Victorian Labor leadership
items.description: A delegation of Labor ministers and MPs has met with Jacinta Allan to urge her to step down, but the Victorian premier has vowed to fight any leadership challenge.

items.title: 'At the gates': Wildfires edge toward wine city of Bordeaux
items.description: Flames from wildfires burning in south-west France are creeping ever closer to Bordeaux, but the mayor says, for now, an evacuation is not on the cards.

items.title: Nurse dies in 'senseless' head-on crash after DV offender flees stabbing scene
items.description: A man says it is "unfair" his wife and the mother of their two young boys has died following a head-on car crash with a man police say had been driving erratically after stabbing his partner.

items.title: Hear that siren? That was the first test of a national emergency alert
items.description: Australia gets its first taste of a new nationwide emergency warning system as millions of devices across the country sound off simultaneously.

items.title: We had the origin of more than 200 tomato products tested. The results were shocking
items.description: One of Australia's biggest tomato brands and two major supermarkets are selling products that exclusive forensic testing shows have misleading labelling.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
